page_title: ARS 5-0 SHU | Arsenal v Sheffield Utd 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+11' What a big chance! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
90+9' Tim Robinson sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+9' The Arsenal players halt their celebrations as referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.

90+6' 5 - 0 Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) blasts the ball inside the right post after a well-executed corner kick deep into the box. Thanks to his strong and precise shot, the goalkeeper had no chance of stopping it.
90+6' The referee awards a corner and Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) goes over to take it.

90+6' He should have scored! Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+4' Sheffield Utd fail to score from a corner as David Raya (Arsenal) leaps to collect the ball.
90+3' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90' 10 additional min. will be played.
89' It's time for a substitution. Mohamed Elneny (Arsenal) comes on in place of Declan Rice.
88' 4 - 0 Goal! Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Wesley Foderingham to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
88' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
87' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
87' The Arsenal players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

86' Play continues despite the shouts by some Arsenal players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Tim Robinson interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
85' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
84' The attendance is 60153.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Gustavo Hamer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ryan One (Sheffield Utd).
80' The Arsenal players can’t believe it after referee Tim Robinson signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
80' There's a break in play and referee Tim Robinson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Arsenal using VAR. This could be interesting!
79' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
76' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) coming on for Emile Smith Rowe.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) replaces Bukayo Saka.
71' Paul Heckingbottom has decided to make a change. John Fleck (Sheffield Utd) replaces James McAtee.
71' The referee signals a substitution. George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Jayden Bogle.

71' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
70' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
66' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) replacing Gabriel Martinelli.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) is coming onto the pitch as Ben White cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' The free kick from long range, taken by Sheffield Utd, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
60' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) is the one who receives a yellow card.
59' Paul Heckingbottom prepares a substitution. Rhian Brewster is replaced by Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anis Slimane trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd).

58' 3 - 0 Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the top left corner.
57' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
53' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Tim Robinson to decide. The relieved Arsenal players can finally celebrate.
52' The Arsenal players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
50' 2 - 0 Goal! Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 2:0.
49' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) steps up to send the ball in.
46' Tim Robinson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
43' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
42' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
42' The resulting set piece from Arsenal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

41' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) inside the box. He lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. Arsenal win a corner.
39' Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar.
36' Arsenal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

36' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Arsenal force a corner. They send men into the box.
32' Ben White (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) was set free in the area by Declan Rice and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
25' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
23' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Declan Rice (Arsenal) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
13' A cross from a corner kick by Arsenal is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

13' The ball is cleared after Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
7' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
2' An attempted cross from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared.
1' The match has just started.
Sheffield Utd will kick-off.
Tim Robinson was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
